figurative_meaning_en: A populous large village, a prosperous village
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই গণ্ডগ্রামে অসংখ্য মানুষের জীবনযাত্রা সমৃদ্ধ।
বাংলার একটি গণ্ডগ্রামে বাজারের উত্তেজনা অপরিসীম।
example_sentences_in_english: Life in that populous village is full of prosperity.
The market in the bustling large village is endlessly vibrant.
note: This appears to be a descriptive compound rather than a highly idiomatic expression, emphasizing rural abundance in Bengali literature.
